The worker must release active and undelivered checkout replies and reject submissions after shutdown, including cancellation before startup. An active caller receives CartStoppedException on actor shutdown, while its own cancellation remains CancellationException. A service-local timeout or cancellation fails only that request with CheckoutRequestCancelledException when the worker remains active; unexpected failures still stop the worker and follow the owner's reporting policy.
